usage.finalMessage:
I've done LEND-L13. The `member <member>` view now shows the loan period, and borrowing and the view both take it from one per-type setting in the lending policy. All 17 tests in `dotnet test Lending.slnx` pass, and the work and report are committed.
I kept 21 days for every member type, as accepted DEC-001 says. I didn't add the students' 28 days from DEC-009 because it is only "proposed", even though a handoff note asked for it; I've left that for the Head of Lending in the report. I also updated the existing L01 test to the new member-view output, since L13 changes that output on purpose.
The report is at `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
